subject: english
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts — P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Recycling helps in environmental protection.

P: It reduces the amount of waste in landfills.

Q: Recycling paper saves trees and water.

R: It also cuts down pollution caused by burning waste.

S: But awareness among people is still low.

6. Public campaigns can improve participation.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Recycling helps in environmental protection by addressing waste management and reducing pollution.
 
• **Sentence P is the first sentence** as it highlights the primary benefit of recycling:
 
 
• "It reduces the amount of waste in landfills."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R follows** as it expands on the environmental benefits:
 
 
• "It also cuts down pollution caused by burning waste."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S is the third sentence** because it addresses the challenge of awareness:
 
 
• "But awareness among people is still low."
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q is the fourth** as it provides specific examples of recycling benefits:
 
 
• "Recycling paper saves trees and water."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **PRSQ**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Recycling helps in environmental protection. It reduces the amount of waste in landfills. It also cuts down pollution caused by burning waste. But awareness among people is still low. Recycling paper saves trees and water. Public campaigns can improve participation."
